mechanism_and_subunit_preference_with_as: Complete block of the preparation of the WWOX source at 50 micromolar; subunit preference mild (rat Ki about 0.14x and 0.6x, mildly GluN2A-preferring) per compiled ChEMBL grading
measured_values: bursts eliminated at 50 micromolar (51 bursts, 5 slices, 3 animals); competitive and surmountable, so occupancy falls when glutamate rises in a burst
exposure: none (tool compound, no human exposure found in earlier notes); no free-exposure value collected
note: Dependence reference only; cannot identify defect or subunit.

identity_class: GluN2B negative allosteric modulator (ifenprodil site), tool compound
mechanism_and_subunit_preference_with_as: Compiled oocyte values 9 nM (GluN2B) versus 52,000 nM (GluN2A) from a review of Fischer 1997 (NR1C clones, species not stated at abstract level)
measured_values: 9 vs 52,000 nM (compilation, conditions of the primary paper unread)
note: Window of 10^2 to 10^3 is a cross-paper compilation, not one experiment.

mechanism_and_subunit_preference_with_as: Third-source oocyte set-up: 100 micromolar glutamate and glycine, pH 7.3, -60 mV: 155 nM (GluN2B) and 28 micromolar (GluN2A); compiled Hess 1996: 110 vs 39,500 nM (about 350-fold in abstract)
measured_values: 155 nM vs 28 micromolar (about 180-fold); native cortical neuron high-affinity IC50 0.21 micromolar (WO-12)
alternative_actions: sigma and alpha-1 actions are prior knowledge, UNVERIFIED in the earlier packages
note: Inhibition is incomplete and pH and agonist-level dependent (carried).

mechanism_and_subunit_preference_with_as: In vitro potency on GluN2B complexes only (IC50 about 4 to 70 nM across assays; mouse GluN2B 3.2 nM; ChEMBL CHEMBL182066 queried 2026-10-29 in earlier note); GluN2A potency not retrievable
measured_values: new in vivo: reduced audiogenic seizures in a GluN2A gain-of-function mouse line, female more than male (abstract)
exposure: human exposure exists in earlier notes (adults, three infants, registered paediatric studies); no free brain exposure value collected here; no administered amounts reproduced
note: Efficacy in a GluN2A-lesioned line shows the lever, not the lesion.

identity_class: uncompetitive open-channel pore blocker, fast off-rate
mechanism_and_subunit_preference_with_as: Autaptic rat hippocampal neurons, room temperature: 1 micromolar blocked 27.1% (synaptic, -70 mV, step to +80 mV) and 50.4% (extrasynaptic, bath 100 micromolar NMDA plus 10 micromolar glycine); 10 micromolar with 1 mM Mg2+ at -25 mV: 39.8% and 64.3%; little NR2-subunit preference; Mg2+ and Ca2+ dependence from earlier notes
exposure: nominal bath concentrations only; the paper cites 10 micromolar as the concentration estimated at the channel after therapeutic dosing; free reachable concentration in the WWOX preparation is not established
alternative_actions: other targets not collected here; ChEMBL "negative allosteric modulator" label is vocabulary, not site
note: Not selective for extrasynaptic receptors in kind. Time-scale premise (minutes) differs from burst duration (about a second).

mechanism_and_subunit_preference_with_as: Indistinguishable from memantine on steady-state current, EPSC decay, repetitive inhibition and extrasynaptic inhibition at equimolar concentration (abstract); more neuroprotective under oxygen-glucose deprivation
note: Memantine plus ketamine is not an informative pair for physiology; do not read it as a subunit contrast.

identity_class: uncompetitive pore blocker, trapping, slow off
mechanism_and_subunit_preference_with_as: Autaptic neurons: about 94% block of synaptic and about 96% of extrasynaptic at 1 micromolar; ratio 1.02
note: Same class label as memantine, different behaviour: properties are not transferable across pore blockers.
